verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean states the chain in the radial variable R = √(2X) and in three pieces rather than one display: Π_n(0,η) = 0 is pressureHistory_axis (the primitive has zero axis datum, as in (5.15)); Π_n(R,η) = ∫_0^R ∂_RΠ_n is the definition of pressureHistory; ∫_0^R = ∫_0^∞ = m_{n,3}(η) = 0 beyond the support is the one-line proof of pressureHistory_exterior (rw [pressureHistory, primitive, ← positiveIntegral_eq_primitive hB hR (hs eta), hm eta]), with the third moment supplied by pressureHistory_exterior_of_moments. The X-coordinate form (5.15) and the R-coordinate gradient used here are identified by pressureGradient_eq_X_equation. As in eq-p052-4 the threshold is an abstract B with the hypothesis ∂_RΠ_n = 0 for R ≥ B, where the paper argues that every product φ_iφ_j with i+j=n carries a positive-order factor and so fixes B = R_+ = √(2X_+).
